title: Activists disrupt German military exhibit over arms sales to Israel
content: Activists disrupt German military exhibit over arms sales to Israel Activists disrupt German military exhibit over arms sales to Israel Pro-Palestine activists interrupted an army recruitment event during German Armed Forces Day. They climbed onto a tank and unfurled a banner reading ‘Genocide with German weapons’ and named Rheinmetall, a key arms supplier to Israel’s military. Published On 6 Jun 2026
